newer_changes_search: Web search (socialjustice.gov.in, PIB, NSP, press) for 2025-2026 PMS-SC changes: press reports say MoSJE has proposed raising the income limit to Rs 4.5 lakh with a course-fee cap and a revised funding pattern, but I found no notification or Cabinet approval; Rs 2.5 lakh remains the notified limit. No 2026-31 continuation approval found; 15th-FC schemes were extended on the same terms to 30 Sep 2026 or approval. The guidelines (2020-21 to 2025-26) are still the ones on the MSJE scheme page, and 2026-27 applications are open on state portals/NSP, so the expired period is minor.

findings.note: <= 250000 matches 'does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/-'. A proposal to raise it to Rs 4.5 lakh is pending; if notified, this rule and its fixtures must change.
findings.suggestion: Keep reverify_days short (90) and watch MoSJE/PIB.

findings.note: Scheme period in the guidelines is 2020-21 to 2025-26 (para 'continued upto the financial year 2025-26'). No replacement published yet.

Hosted on socialwelfare.goa.gov.in (a state government site) as a copy of the GoI guidelines; acceptable as official, and the MSJE page (msje snapshot) confirms the 'revised in March 2021' guidelines are current.

caste_certificate, income_certificate and aadhaar cite 'guidelines' (scanned, 188-byte snapshot, no text); marksheet, fee_receipt, bank_account and photo cite 'nsp', whose snapshot is only page chrome. guidelines_text supports most of them (line 422: marksheets, caste certificate, income certificate; line 274: Aadhaar-linked bank account).
findings.suggestion: Re-point caste_certificate, income_certificate, aadhaar, marksheet and bank_account to guidelines_text; keep fee_receipt/photo only if a text source lists them.
